Title: Public Preview: Windows Annual Channel on AKS

Body.Content:
Windows Server Annual Channel for Containers is now in public preview on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS). With the Annual Channel, you’ll not only get the latest release in Windows Server but also get the added benefit of portability between container hosts and container images. Windows Server 2022 container images are able to run on the newer Annual Channel container host, therefore easing migration pains when upgrading.

Learn more.
